newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end mildly firm ahead expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end mildly firm ahead expiry.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended slightly firmer on Wednesday as players booked profits and squared their positions a day ahead of the September contract's expiry.
Dealers said the market was likely to trade sideways as players would be reluctant to open new positions before the close of the Japanese fiscal half-year at the end of September.
After losing ground on some early profit-taking, Nikkei 225 September futures recovered to 20,585 against their previous settlement at 20,575. The December contract finished at 20,595 against 20,590.
A trader with a European futures house said the market had failed to extend its gains after Tuesday's sharp rise, as the expected investment fund buying did not materialise.
He said the lead December contract would be supported at 20,500 and 20,300, with initial resistance at 20,660.
